  {T : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TuringMachines.Machine A Q}
  (L : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.Labeling T) (c q b : ℕ)
  (m : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TuringMachines.Move)
  (hc : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.Valid (Fintype.card Γ) (Fintype.card Q) c)
  (hw :
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.lookup L (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.stateCode c)

      1 + Nat.pair q (Nat.pair b (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.moveCode m))) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.transition L c =
    match m, hw with
    | Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TuringMachines.Move.left, hw =>
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.pack q
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.head
          (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.leftCode c))
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.tail

        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.cons b
          (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.rightCode c))
    | Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TuringMachines.Move.stay, hw =>
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.pack q b (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.leftCode c)
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.rightCode c)
    | Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TuringMachines.Move.right, hw =>
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.pack q
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.head
          (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.rightCode c))
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.cons b
          (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.TapeCoding.leftCode c))
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.tail
